intro: One regular fast food beef burger is an estimated 300 kcal. Most of the calories come from the bun and beef patty.

variants.name: Burger set + medium fries + soft drink

diet: Yes, a regular beef burger is actually one of the lighter options at fast food places. What makes calories shoot up is the set: fries and soft drink. Order just the burger with plain water and it fits your diet. Add some veg or fruit at home to feel fuller.
tips: Order the burger ala carte, not the set.
Swap the soft drink for plain water or a zero-sugar drink.
If you're hungry, get two regular burgers instead of one big saucy burger.

swap.name: Beef burger + corn cup + plain water
swap.why: Compared to the usual set at about 800 kcal, this saves almost half and still keeps you full.

faq.q: Do fast food beef burgers use real beef?
faq.a: Most big chains use beef patties. Seasoning and other ingredients differ by brand.

faq.q: What's the difference between a hamburger and a cheeseburger?
faq.a: A cheeseburger has an extra slice of cheese. It tastes richer and is slightly higher in calories.
Once in a while is okay. Pick the regular size and pair it with plain water or milk.
